Done. Summary of what happened:

**Diagnosis:** checkout-api v2.3.1 was failing health checks in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an ~18% error rate. The most recent previously-healthy production release was **v2.3.0**.

**Remediation:** Rolled back checkout-api to v2.3.0 in all regions.
- The first rollback attempt partially failed (orchestrator error halted after us-east, leaving regions on mixed versions).
- Retried the rollback, which succeeded across all regions.
- Verified the service is now healthy on v2.3.0 everywhere, with the error rate down to 0.2%.

**Incident:** Opened **INC-0001** (SEV2) for checkout-api documenting the health-check failures, the rollback to v2.3.0 (including the orchestrator hiccup and retry), and a recommendation to root-cause v2.3.1 before any redeploy. The on-call engineer has been paged.
